symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of cyclic axes, that is, the number of coordinates in each map value.
symbols.quote: Write $r$ for the number of cyclic axes, not the digit count of the earlier page.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: An index of a cyclic axis, running over 1 to r.
symbols.quote: Write $a$ for an axis index, $1 \le a \le r$, and $t_a$ for the number of positions along axis $a$; the lengths $t_1,\dots,t_r$ are pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along axis a.
symbols.quote: Write $a$ for an axis index, $1 \le a \le r$, and $t_a$ for the number of positions along axis $a$; the lengths $t_1,\dots,t_r$ are pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: total positions
symbols.meaning: The total number of positions, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Put $T = t_1 t_2 \cdots t_r$, the total number of positions.

symbols.name: cyclic position
symbols.meaning: A position on the cycle of length T, with 0 at most p less than T.
symbols.quote: Write $p$ and $q$ for cyclic positions, $0 \le p, q < T$, and $w$ for an output position.

symbols.name: second cyclic position
symbols.meaning: A second position on the cycle of length T, with 0 at most q less than T.
symbols.quote: Write $p$ and $q$ for cyclic positions, $0 \le p, q < T$, and $w$ for an output position.

symbols.name: output position
symbols.meaning: The position of an output coefficient of the convolution, with 0 at most w less than T.
symbols.quote: Write $p$ and $q$ for cyclic positions, $0 \le p, q < T$, and $w$ for an output position.

symbols.name: Chinese-remainder map
symbols.meaning: The map sending a position to the tuple of its residues modulo the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: The map $\phi$ sends a position $p$ to the tuple of its residues:

relations.quote: The map is applied to the coefficients of [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md).
